Located by two repository sweeps run against all 372 families; every quote was checked verbatim against its file by check_stale_quotes.py. Dated records and retrodiction encodings listed here are deliberately NOT edited: they record what was known when they were written. RESULT_INTAKE.md sec 5 says which live documents were annotated instead.
